## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND show risk-tilt, while HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND / LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND) signals credit stress rising — mixed confirmations support a Neutral regime.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ratio (Level: 0.7511, 1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.49%) ↑ rising indicates widening credit pressure. Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND, while Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +7.17%) → flat ABOVE TREND is neutral-positive for equities.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar modestly soft: UUP proxy (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -0.78%) → flat BELOW TREND and yield sensitivity remains intact as TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND. Yield curve flattening (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -2.85%) → flat BELOW TREND keeps financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leadership: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials/Cloud/Software ETFs (SKYY (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +21.23%) ABOVE TREND; IGV (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +11.08%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength. Tech (XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND) and Financials (XLF (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +3.03%) ABOVE TREND) are both positive, so Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND shows EM participation. China weakness: FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION, and VGK (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +4.03%) in CORRECTION signals regional divergence.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation mixed: ARKK (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND show risk appetite, while IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND flags crypto pullback.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND are leading commodity gains. Industrial metals/CPER (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND supports cyclical demand signals.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is dominant: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND both rallying strongly. Natural gas recovering: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND show consistent upside. DIVERGENCE: Credit signal (HYG/LQD rising) and regional corrections (FXI, VGK, XLY in CORRECTION) create cross-currents — this is a minor-to-moderate divergence environment.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Energy and secular growth/tech ETFs (XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to China/regionals showing correction (FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION) and speculative crypto (IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND). Bonds (TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND) remain neutral-monitor.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and SKYY (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +21.23%) ABOVE TREND for momentum flows. BEARISH: XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION and XLP (Consumer Staples, 1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND for relative weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY remains fragile on 1M weakness.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.75 (credit health watch) with HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND / LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND; XLK/XLF pivot at 3.2670 (Tech vs Financials) to monitor leadership shifts; SPY/TLT ~9.4629 (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND for equity risk tone.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but mixed signals from rising credit stress and falling VXX keep the market balanced. Energy (XLE) and Tech/structured growth (XLK, SKYY) showing strength while China/consumer discretionary (FXI, XLY) are key divergences to monitor.
